items.title: Update 0.5.0.30
items.summary: This update adds a button that lets you turn in all completed investigation stages at once, and shop tabs no longer disappear after a raid. Fire now burns the ground and grass, and the RPG-7 is effective against vehicles and dangerous enemies again.

items.title: Major Update "To the sky"
items.summary: The Agency has stabilized a portal to the complex floating above Saltriver City. Now you can enter the "Vanilla" skyscraper and find out what secrets the Icarus corporation is hiding in its offices. Signals are coming in from the power plant in Anguka Anga, and a new threat has been spotted on Dalniy Island.

items.title: Scheduled Maintenance
items.summary: Operatives! Today, on November 11th (12:00 UTC), the game servers will be taken offline for scheduled maintenance to deploy the "To the sky" major update. The game may be unavailable until maintenance is complete. Follow us on social media and check the website for updates!

items.title: New Calibers and Weapons: Expanding the Arsenal
items.summary: .300 BLK: For the Quiet Professionals A new subsonic round in the Agency’s arsenal. Paired with a suppressor, it makes for truly quiet shooting. – a familiar bullpup in a new variation. Unlike the A1, it trades the built-in optic for a rail that takes any scope.

items.title: "Power Plant": A Signal from Anguka Anga
items.summary: Operatives! The Agency has cleared a route into a previously inaccessible sector of Anguka Anga. West of Headquarters, an unfinished power plant has been discovered — and it looks like it wasn’t built just to generate electricity.

items.title: Upcoming Raid "Icarus Offices": America is Going Higher
items.summary: Operatives are already familiar with these colossal towers looming on the horizon in the "Downtown"' raid. The Agency has long suspected this district was the epicenter of the incident in a different timeline.

items.title: Developer Q&A: November 2026
items.summary: Squad & Matchmaking Will Isolated Raids receive matchmaking or auto-fill options so solo players can group up with random operatives, or so duos can queue with a third teammate? Are there any other improvements planned for the auto-fill squad system? We are actively working on expanding our squad functionality and…

items.title: Update 0.4.0.215
items.summary: Investigations and Items Anomalous Biomass now drops from Swarm Hives and the Alpha Flowerman. The volume of Anomalous Biomass has been reduced so that more can be carried in the inventory. Interface Fixed incorrect tooltip text regarding the reward for a kill made by a Distorted Hunter.

items.title: To hell: "Factory: Bloodbath"
items.summary: Infiltrate the blood-soaked factory, track down encrypted data drives, and carve through rampaging hostiles. Secure your haul, extract to the Shelter - and the Agency will make it worth your while with generous rewards.

items.title: Armored Support: BTR-80A
items.summary: raids. For those not up to speed: the BTR-80A has eight wheels, a 30 mm autocannon and armor that shrugs off bullets and claws alike. Finding one is easy. But without fuel and ammo it’s dead weight, so you’ll also have to scavenge a fuel canister and ammunition. Whoever pulls it off first takes the wheel.

items.title: The Agency’s Readings Have Breached Critical Thresholds!
items.summary: Attention, Operatives! Rifts have fractured the boundary between our sector and an adjacent branch of the Multiverse. Through these fractures, "residual imprints" are leaking into our quantum-unstable zones — echoes of entities erased from alternate timelines. But hostiles aren’t the only things crossing over.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.208
items.summary: Gameplay and Balance Pressing the fence-cutting keybind again no longer cancel the action once it has begun. Fixed instances of camera "jitter" when the direction of gravity changed. Fall damage has been restored to its intended values.

items.title: Frightfully Good Deal: Active Matter at the "Steam Scream V" Festival!
items.summary: Eyeing the Advanced or Deluxe Edition? They'll get cheaper too: both editions include the Standard Edition. Call your friends and dive into anomalous zones you wouldn't dare raid alone.

items.title: Active Matter on Steam Deck!
items.summary: Thanks to every Operative playing the game on these devices and sharing their impressions. We’ll see you in the Multiverse!

items.title: Over 500,000 Copies of Active Matter!
items.summary: “Half a million copies is a very strong result for a hardcore game like ours,” says Anton Yudintsev, co-founder of Gaijin Entertainment. “What is especially encouraging is that sales have remained remarkably steady since launch.

items.title: Test your perception
items.summary: Operatives, time to test your attention to detail! The Agency has received two images of the same location, but the details don’t match. Spot five differences and report your findings in the comments. Take your time: some changes are easy to miss! [img src=" [img src="

items.title: Extinguish on Sight: Firestorm
items.summary: Site Status: Fully engulfed in flames. Clearance: Open Raid, solo only. Threats: Burning Devourers, Scorches, fire anomalies, and hostile rival Operatives. Objective: Track the anomalous signals, locate the sources of ignition, and extract alive. Equipment: Got a fire extinguisher? Equip it in a weapon slot.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.205
items.summary: In this update, markers made on the map, and shown on the compass, now show distance and elevation more clearly. The “Repair All” inventory button now also repairs armor being carried as spares, and DualSense touchpad functionality hs been improved.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.201
items.summary: Fixed muzzle flash hiders as they now once again help conceal your position when firing. Resolved several gameplay bugs in raids and made interface improvements. Controls have been further refined and performance on consoles has been improved.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.199
items.summary: Interface Gear presets now equip correctly when pressing the "Purchase and Equip" button. Gear presets are now purchased without camouflages: if the preset included a camouflage on a weapon, it won't be purchased or applied. You can apply one separately afterwards as normal.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.196
items.summary: Controls The weapon tactical flashlight and laser sight can once again be toggled separately. By default, both options are bound to the same control (“L” on keyboard), but you can assign a different binding to either of them in the controls settings.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.195
items.summary: Managing gear has become less of a hassle, magazines no longer can drop on reload, visual recoil when using scopes has been adjusted, and improved item swapping when changing backpacks and safe containers at the Shelter.

items.title: Signal Lost
items.summary: URGENT! We've lost contact with one of our Operatives, and a sudden anomaly has wiped the data on which raid they deployed to. But, their camera transmitted one final frame, and the zone is about to collapse with them still inside.

items.title: Server update
items.summary: Extended the search time of the auto-fill squad feature, it should find players twice as often now.

items.title: Active Matter: Activity Report
items.summary: How have we already improved the game? Here are just a few examples of what we’ve fixed in recent days and weeks. Fewer motion sickness-inducing effects reduce camera bobbing while moving directly in the game’s settings menu.

items.title: Update 0.4.0.182
items.summary: Gameplay and Balance Rare "Guts" and "Ghost" Body Sleeves have been reworked: they are now "epic" Body Sleeves with the same characteristics as the "Knight" and "Paladin" Body Sleeves. In Isolated (PvE) Raids, Invisibles and Hellhounds no longer suddenly spawn near players who remain in one area for a long time.
